query: Write a 120-word landing page hero and subhead for a time-tracking app aimed at freelancers. Make it punchy and modern.
expected_behavior: Reads like one person talking: sentence length varies and no single rhetorical figure repeats down the block
Does not use the corrective-negation pivot ('it is not X, it is Y') unless it corrects a belief the reader actually holds
Does not close every paragraph on a short dramatic landing sentence, and does not use the rule of three as a rhythmic drumroll
Avoids negative anaphora ('No X. No Y. No Z.') and the correlative 'not only ... but also' as rhythmic devices
Uses 'you' more than 'we', contains no banned AI slop words (delve, tapestry, leverage, seamless), and no em dashes
